verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says an on-call engineer can request cover from a colleague with one click and can create overrides with one click, so the engineer handles coverage changes without rebuilding the schedule. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: an explicit shift-swap feature, in-depth docs on the override and cover-request workflow and on permissions (non-admin self-service), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule

citations.quote: Ask a colleague to cover for you with a single click on the “Request cover” button.
Create overrides with a single click
Manage on-call schedules from our built-in web interface or keep them in a shared Google calendar.
